Nike Atelier for Sha’Carri Richardson reflects the beauty of London after rainfall through luminous details, weathered textures, and sculptural silhouettes defined by strength and movement.

The bespoke look debuts on the red carpet at @athlos A26 in London. 

Built to push beyond convention, the Nike FlyWeb bra uses computational design to engineer fit and support down to the millimeter. Precision-made for an athlete redefining power on and off the track.

The Nike Atelier Vomero Premium takes a performance silhouette into new territory, embellished with hand-set Swarovski® Crystals shimmering like water droplets above reflective Air Zoom units.

“You don’t have to choose one version of yourself. Every side of you can be powerful.”

Sha’Carri Richardson

Light and movement shape every detail of the Nike Atelier jacket, with hand-set Swarovski® Crystals that catch the light like raindrops across the reflective outer layer.

Made in Japan from premium crackled leather, the Nike Atelier Duffel Mini is accessorized with oversized custom charms that celebrate Sha’Carri’s connection to the track.

Nike Atelier. One of One.

You were right to be worried about Addisu Gobena. 

The 21-year-old just bagged his first major marathon win in Sydney.

New record just dropped.

The 100M hurdles World Record belongs to @masai_russell. And it’s flying off the shelves.

“I love LA so much. It’s motivating to have a bunch of women around you who are all putting their minds toward a big goal.”

Run club founder @brettsbites has her eyes fixed on the After Dark Tour finish line. 

Race the night away with Brett at the LA After Dark Tour on October 24th.

“The After Dark Tour is one of those moments you can’t really explain. You just have to be there to experience it.”

For ultrarunner @elysesenelefao, it doesn’t matter where you start from. On race day, we’re all going the same direction.

Feel the power and chase the vibe with Elyse on September 27th at the Sydney After Dark Tour.

“Running in Mexico City feels wild. The vibe. The energy. It feels free.”

The city doesn’t just inspire chef and runner @reginalogar, it fuels her.

Lace up with Regina at the Mexico City After Dark Tour on October 3rd.

“I’ve found such an amazing running community in London. It’s made me want to train more.”

Runner @rehanajade has learned to enjoy the grind of training. The only thing left is to enjoy the race.

Lock in with Rehana at the London After Dark Tour on October 17th.

“What makes the After Dark Tour special is showing up and feeling the community. It’s magical.”

Podcast duo @domrobxrts and @mayamoto_ don’t just run for the distance, they run for the neighborhood.

Take to the streets with Dom & Maya in LA on October 24th.

“Running in Manila can be described in one word: resilient.”

Taekwondo champion @pauweenie is channeling the energy of her city as she trains for the After Dark Tour.

Go stride for stride with Pauline at the Manila After Dark Tour on November 21st.

“Running in Mumbai feels like you’re running in a video game. It’s really fun.”

For musician and run club founder @sahirahoshidar, you can’t train hard without playing hard.

Join her as she takes on the Mumbai After Dark Tour on December 12th.
After a 10-month hiatus, @jakobing takes 5000m gold in Birmingham. Welcome back.

3,800 runners took over the streets of Shanghai on Saturday night to race the night away. Elite half marathoner Yin Xiaoyu and her sister Xiaobing were among the collective of runners chasing down the city’s iconic skyline.

In the words of Xiaoyu: “When my sister is beside me, no distance stands a chance.”

For over a century, Japanese students have run in a relay race that puts both the heart and the spirit to the test.

And only one team’s tasuki can cross the line first.

日本の学生達が100年以上つないで来たレース。
努力、想い、そして魂を一本の襷に込めて仲間たちに託される。

手渡しされる襷は、目に見える。
でもそれは、見えないすべてからできているできている。
積み重ねた力をつなげ。

The only way to find out how far you can go is to push yourself to the end. 

If it was easy, it wouldn’t be NXN.

Hills that test your legs. Conditions that test your soul.

Welcome to Nike Cross Nationals—the hardest 16 minutes of the year. The carnage begins tomorrow.

5,000 women lit up London for an After Dark Tour like no other.

1K to find their opponents. 10K to race them. When the spotlight shone, the city showed up.

An epic race demanded an epic line-up.
This was After Dark Tour London.

Embrace the elements, not the excuses.

Make inclement weather your advantage in the Vomero 18 GORE-TEX. Available now.

“My dream is to make this world a running world.” -@kipchogeeliud 

The new Eliud Kipchoge Collection. Inspired by Kenya and those who power his relentless devotion to running.

@kipchogeeliud proves that no human is limited. Not by doubt. Not by distance. And never by time. 

Greatness doesn’t ask if there’s a finish line. It asks: where do we run next?
In a sport dominated by time, Eliud Kipchoge’s legacy is timeless.

Your next zero gravity run is coming.
